scenario: [LERR.1.4.9]'s DOMAIN row on a raiser IEEE 754 does not own: a shift count that is negative at run time ([LEXP.7.14.1], [LERR.1.4.10]). A ComputationError with TRAP_DOMAIN, not a TypeError: the operands are well-typed Ints and the operation is valid at the site — it simply has no answer ([LERR.1] rung 6). PATH PINNED: the bitwise arm of `ds_rete_eval` in rete/eval.c, the `rv.i < 0` test before `ds_i64_shl` / `ds_i64_shr`, and the Mercury shift arm. The count is a slot read, so the negative is a runtime value and the compiler cannot refuse it ([LEXP.7.8]).
